Each opt-in rule: selected read/binary/decode/path-rejection aggregate gap under count limit -> SKIPPED, without inferred cause count
Each opt-in rule: selected syntax gap -> SKIPPED
Each opt-in rule: evidence before cap and nonempty result -> unchanged complete findings
Evidence after cap is not claimed observed; empty check veto occurs from counts only
Default unobserved synthetic PyScanResult cannot establish full view

applies=false and dynamic/non-opt-in paths stay unchanged

Registry docstring is wrapped in the final inert patch.
Initial condition explicitly includes inconsistent coverage; final compatibility sentence requires consistent observed counts and parsed=candidate.

patch_review.d41: core/engine.py patch requires explicit maintainer review of the concrete patch before implementation
patch_review.engine: Only after an applicable built-in check returns an empty list; nonempty/generated/applies=false paths unchanged
patch_review.review_method: Read exact frozen inert patch bytes and compare their stated branches with current source/interface contracts. Did not apply, compile or execute future implementation.
patch_review.spec: Explicitly scopes two-rule conservative veto and preserves mixed failure debt as OPEN, not verified universal violation
patch_review.unavailable: Concrete code first handles unobserved or invalid counts with fixed unavailable reason, then handles consistent no-gap or normal-gap cases; normative patch matches this order and meaning.

selected_scope.active_zero_budget: Valid with observed=True. Zero candidates is exhausted for the captured view; nonzero candidates with selected=parsed=0 have a normal selection gap. The observation marker, not file_limit, identifies an unobserved default result.
selected_scope.consistent_no_gap: Observed counts satisfy all invariants and parsed == candidate -> no hook reason; preserve current PASS behavior without certifying other scopes
selected_scope.facts: Frozen PythonCandidateCoverage derived from existing four counters plus an explicit internal coverage_observed marker
selected_scope.hook: Rule.pass_skip_reason(ctx) -> str | None; default None; only built-in empty check result
selected_scope.limited: Parsed less than candidate -> existing SKIPPED/INFO for the two empty applicable rules
selected_scope.name: Known primary-Python candidate-view gaps veto synthetic PASS
preserved: Nonempty findings, including existing bounded absence findings
All other built-in and generated project rules
Persisted schemas, rule IDs, severities and default fail-on thresholds
selected_scope.unavailable_reason: Python candidate coverage is unavailable; no rule-wide PASS is established.
selected_scope.unknown: Unobserved or count-inconsistent internal coverage -> existing SKIPPED/INFO using one fixed unavailable reason for the two empty applicable rules; upstream untracked domains are not mapped to this state
selected_scope.whole_r07c_status: OPEN; this is only a named local stage
